title: Bud Powell's breakdown in Philadelphia
summary: Bud came in late and wild at a Philadelphia date, was beaten by police and hospitalised in Bellevue, and never returned.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy
